caption: The drawing depicts a square quilt composed of triangles arranged in a geometric pattern. The quilt features a patchwork design with a variety of colored and patterned fabrics, including shades of red, blue, brown, white, and pink. The outer corners and the side centers of the quilt are filled with solid red fabric sections containing small darker motifs. The interior consists of many repeated units of half-square triangles, with each unit featuring two contrasting fabrics, such as dark blue with white, red with cream, brown with light tan, and pink with printed white. Some patches have checkered, dotted, floral, or striped patterns. The quilt is bordered by a thin red binding and the quilting stitches are visible, running in parallel diagonal and straight lines throughout the design. The overall arrangement forms a large central diamond motif surrounded by smaller triangles and patterned sections.
title: Patchwork Quilt
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
